integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from the cited one-map monotone-subset corollary. The finite-family half is an iteration; the countable-family obstruction is an explicit binary-coordinate construction. Self-review only.
scientific_limitations: The countable-family obstruction is stated in ZFC and uses an injection from omega_1 into Cantor space; no claim is made for ZF alone, eventual monotonicity, or arbitrary structured families.
title: Finite-versus-countable monotone-subset boundary at \(\omega_1\)
